development_policy: Only fixture IDs listed in split-manifest-v1.json may be used for implementation or tuning.
held_out_policy: Reserved held-out IDs may not be opened, relabeled, or reassigned during implementation. Empty reservations mean the final gate is pending.
reporting_rules: Every rate includes numerator, denominator, and sample count.
Zero accepted claims has undefined precision, never 100 percent.
Facts are canonicalized, deduplicated, and matched one-to-one.
First and repaired outputs are reported separately.
Natural hallucinations and injected adversarial errors are separate strata.
Synthetic oracle tests validate code but do not establish natural model quality.
Unreviewed human labels keep the report PRELIMINARY/UNVALIDATED.
No observed error count is described as universal soundness.
